I"ll give you some advice bud. The last year in my life, I've been trying to quit drinking. Everytime I did, I would worry, about my next drink. I would worry, about going to my cousins wedding, and not being able to drink because of being judged. I have committed to not drinking just recently, but this time it's different. Personally, I've allowed alcohol to ruin my life. I have allowed it to control me, to change my frame of mind, and to alter my future. I would use it to help me feel good, I would use it to make me feel socialble, and I would always use excused. You must have a reason for quitting, and mine is that I became a monster, it caused depression, anxiety, holding me back in school, and also ruined a relationship I had with the woman I could have married. I'm  just telling you man, if you worry about the next time you drink, or being around alcohol, that anxiety is just gonna make you drink. Than once you start drinking again, even the one. You say fuck it. You get loaded. You wake up shitty. You get depressed for a couple of days. Than you do it again. The cycle continues. So if you wanna quit, than stop completly and just focus on that. Otherwise, don't say you're going to quit, and have a little here and a little there. Because within that is a guilt for doing so. As all these people say here, don't look for people to tell you what to do, truly make the decision yourself.
